cards.title: Piezas translúcidas ordenadas como sistema de datos
cards.description: Consistent AgntiaPro art direction: warm editorial European design magazine, ivory #fcfaf6, ink #242421, subtle violet #6550dd and champagne gold #b49665 only as accents, beautiful natural materials, refined realism, quiet cinematic light, generous negative space, excellent photographic composition. No readable text, letters, logos, branding, UI, watermarks, neon, futuristic dashboards, stock-photo clichés.
